business.headline: Traders' board member urges Centre to withdraw 0.4% MDR on UPI paymentsAn NTWB member has asked the Centre to withdraw the 0.4 per cent MDR on UPI merchant payments above Rs 2,000. He said the fee could hit business growth, raise prices and will be taken up at the board's next meeting.

US Federal Reserve raises interest rates for 1st time in 3 years, defying TrumpThe Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter point, with Kevin Warsh backing the unanimous move. The decision signalled more tightening ahead as inflation stayed elevated and markets watched for Warsh's next steps.

UPI industry bleeding money, cannot depend on govt subsidies: PhonePe CEOPhonePe CEO Sameer Nigam defended the new UPI charges, saying payment companies are losing money and cannot keep relying on government subsidies. He said most everyday UPI payments will remain unaffected, while charges on bigger transactions will help make the digital payments system financially sustainable.

UPI MDR from October 15: Who pays, who is exempt? PhonePe CEO explainsThe government has introduced an MDR on select UPI merchant payments from October 15, 2026. The move keeps UPI free for customers while creating a revenue model for the payments industry. PhonePe CEO Sameer Nigam explains who will be affected and who will remain exempt.

False, baseless, misleading: Govt denied UPI MDR last year. Now it's officialIn June 2025, the Finance Ministry issued a statement on X dismissing reports that a Merchant Discount Rate would be charged on UPI transactions. The government has now introduced a 0.4% MDR on select UPI merchant payments above Rs 2,000 from October 15, 2026.

Govt can't subsidise everything: Niti Aayog Vice Chairman backs new UPI chargesNITI Aayog Vice Chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri backed the proposed UPI MDR on certain transactions, saying digital payments have costs and businesses should pay reasonable charges rather than rely on government subsidies. He said the fee should support further growth, while stressing that India needs to diversify its exports and export markets.

Petrol pump dealers seek full UPI MDR exemption on payments above Rs 2,000The All India Petroleum Dealers Association has written to the Finance Minister seeking intervention over the payment processing costs. The letter was sent by association President Ajay Bansal on Wednesday.

No rollback of 0.4% UPI MDR above Rs 2,000, says govt officialThe government sources said the decision has been taken in the larger interest of the UPI ecosystem and to strengthen its safety and security.

OpenAI says no to 2026 IPO: Should anthropic hit pause too?Anthropic is reportedly moving towards a public listing around mid-October, even as concerns over AI safety, the enormous cost of developing frontier models and the sustainability of the industry's spending continue to grow.

Why has govt added 0.4% MDR on merchant UPI payments above Rs 2,000?The government has imposed MDR on select high-value UPI merchant transactions from October 15, 2026. It says the fee will fund infrastructure, security and expansion while keeping consumer payments free.

EPFO wage ceiling raised from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000: Who will benefitThe Union Cabinet on Wednesday approved raising the wage ceiling for mandatory coverage under the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per month.

Sensex, Nifty end higher after 2-day slide; UPI-linked stocks rally, IT dragsThe BSE Sensex opened at 74,249.31 and closed at 74,336.45, rising 332.63 points, or 0.45%, from the previous close. The Nifty 50 opened at 23,201.60 and ended at 23,217.60, gaining 99 points, or 0.43%.

India's August trade gap narrows: Gold imports shrink, oil bill jumpsGovernment data released on Tuesday showed that India's goods trade deficit narrowed to $26.86 billion in August, down from nearly $32 billion in the previous month.

NSE IPO opens tomorrow: Should you subscribe?NSE has a strong position in India's capital markets, with its large trading volumes, technology platform and integrated clearing and settlement ecosystem giving it an important role in the market.

Doesn't really make sense: Nithin Kamath flags a problem with new UPI MDRNithin Kamath has flagged that the new UPI MDR could make brokers pay on client fund transfers even when no trade happens. He said the fee structure may strain broking economics and needs a lower rate for such transfers.

UPI MDR sends shares of Paytm, MobiKwik, Pine Labs higher: Is it time to buy?NPCI has introduced a 0.4% MDR on eligible UPI merchant transactions above Rs 2,000 from 15 October. The move lifted payment stocks and sharpened focus on how the new revenue pool will be shared.

UPI MDR vs credit card, net banking: Do you pay extra for using them?The new UPI MDR will apply to merchant payments above Rs 2,000 from October 15. For customers, the real cost difference still depends more on platform fees, convenience charges and card borrowing costs.

Hero Motors IPO opens today with Rs 19 GMP. Should investors subscribe?Hero Motors' Rs 1,000-crore IPO has opened for subscription from September 16 to 18. A Rs 19 grey market premium points to listing interest, while investors weigh improving finances against concentration and raw material risks.

Sensex, Nifty open higher after hitting 5-month low; oil, Fed decision cap gainsThe BSE Sensex opened at 74,249.31 and was at 74,208.83 at 9:36 am, up 205.01 points or 0.28% from the previous close. The Nifty 50 opened at 23,201.60 and was at 23,188.10, up 69.50 points or 0.30%.

Sensex, Nifty opening: Will stock markets crash again today? Paytm to be in focusGIFT Nifty futures were trading around 23,237 at 8:15 am, indicating a positive start for the Nifty50. The index had closed at 23,118.60 on Tuesday, falling 279.50 points or 1.19%. The Sensex had ended 777.94 points lower at 74,003.82.

entertainment.headline: I felt no vulgarity: Mandakini on Ram Teri Ganga Maili waterfall scene Actor Mandakini has revisited the most-talked-about waterfall and breastfeeding scenes from Raj Kapoor's Ram Teri Ganga Maili, reflecting on the artistic vision behind the iconic sequences.

After Dadasaheb Phalke win, Anant Nag says PM Modi ended award favouritism Anant Nag said Prime Minister Narendra Modi changed award selection by inviting public participation. The veteran actor said the shift ended favouritism and dedicated the honour to Karnataka.

Men need to look inward: Ali Zafar slams Katrina Kaif's post-pregnancy body-shaming Pakistani actor Ali Zafar defended his Mere Brother Ki Dulhan co-actor Katrina Kaif after she faced misogynist remarks over her post-pregnancy appearance. He said women should be valued beyond beauty standards and not judged only by looks.

CM Vijay won't promote son Jason Sanjay's debut film Sigma. Here's why Thalapathy Vijay will not promote Jason Sanjay's Sigma, which will mark the latter's debut as a director. Jason said Vijay is excited to watch Sigma but has many responsibilities as the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister.

Preity Zinta, Suniel Shetty, Pankaj Tripathi among 18 on new censor board panel Actors Preity Zinta, Suniel Shetty, Pankaj Tripathi and Rupali Ganguly have been named among the new members of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) panel.

Such scene on Maharana Pratap song: Court pulls up Mirzapur makers in Shoorveer row Delhi High Court asked the makers of Mirzapur: The Movie to watch the film over the Shoorveer song controversy. The court is hearing a plea seeking the song's removal from the climax featuring gangster characters.

Actor Anant Nag wins Dadasaheb Phalke, PM Modi hails his 'remarkable versatility' Veteran actor Anant Nag will be honoured with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2024 at the 72nd National Film Awards ceremony for his contribution to Indian cinema. Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated him on the achievement.

Taapsee Pannu reacts to Gandhari's criticism, highlights film's top Netflix ranking Actor Taapsee Pannu responded to criticism of Gandhari by sharing its chart-topping streaming performance on the platform. Her post highlighted the gap between mixed critical reviews and the film's strong audience traction following its release.

The Vvaan: Tamannaah Bhatia says Chhathi Maiya song shoot left her teary-eyed Tamannaah Bhatia got emotional while shooting Chhathi Maiya song for The Vvaan. The actor spoke about Chhath Puja and Bihari culture at the film's trailer launch.

No trailer, no pan-India tag: How Nani's The Paradise breaks cinema's usual rules Nani has confirmed that The Paradise will hit theatres on September 24 without a theatrical trailer. Instead of pulling the team away from the final cut to make one, the makers have chosen to let the film speak for itself.

The Vvaan trailer: Sidharth Malhotra, Tamannaah Bhatia face forest temple mystery The Vvaan trailer introduces Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia inside a forest ruled by fear, faith and supernatural forces. It sets up a clash between the Vvaan Devi temple and development plans while hinting at a past-linked transformation.

The Great Indian Kapil Show Season 5 returns with festive comedy. Watch promo Comedian Kapil Sharma's comedy series, The Great Indian Kapil Show, is set to return for a festive-themed fifth season. New episodes will bring back its signature blend of celebrity interviews, ensemble sketches, and interactive host banter.

Pregnant Samantha hugs Raj Nidimoru during sweet Mumbai airport send-off. Watch Actor Samantha shared a warm hug with husband Raj Nidimoru as he saw her off at Mumbai airport. The candid moment comes as the newly married couple prepare to welcome their first child after the success of Maa Inti Bangaaram.

Why have Sooraj Pancholi, Rhea, Dino Morea been named in Disha Salian CBI FIR? The CBI has registered a fresh FIR in the Disha Salian death case, naming Rhea Chakraborty, Sooraj Pancholi and Dino Morea. The FIR covers allegations of gang rape, murder and a cover-up, with the CBI now investigating the claims.

Inside Jyotika-Suriya's 20th anniversary: Vows at church, celebrations on yacht Jyotika and Suriya renewed their vows at a church before celebrating with family and friends on a yacht. The new pictures place their children and close-knit family gathering at the heart of the milestone.

Vijay Sethupathi's Maharaja becomes first Tamil film to get Hollywood remake Maharaja is being set up for a Hollywood remake after its strong run in China. The move has fuelled buzz around the cast, with the agency expected to announce details later.

Zach Cregger is the perfect director to helm Resident Evil: Producers Resident Evil producers say Zach Cregger has built the film around the games' survival horror and uncertainty. They say his immersive real-time approach aims to make audiences share the protagonist's fear.

Why is Ed Sheeran's tour in crisis? All about Macklemore's Palestine remark row Singer Ed Sheeran said rapper Macklemore's removal from the Loop Tour was the promoter's decision after venues objected to his pro-Palestine remarks. The fallout deepened when all four remaining support acts withdrew, widening the row over artist speech and venue control.

Actor Muzammil Ibrahim on joining Salman's Monster, landing action role on his terms Muzammil Ibrahim has joined Salman Khan and Nayanthara's Monster in an action-heavy role. He says the film marks a fresh phase in his career after years of martial arts training and uncertainty.

Chidambaram, Gogoi and 3 Congress MPs were on panel that backed MDR on UPI: BJPBJP sources questioned Rahul Gandhi's opposition to UPI MDR, pointing to a Parliamentary Finance Committee report recommending a tiered revenue model. Five Congress MPs, including P Chidambaram and Manish Tewari, were committee members when the report was adopted. The panel cited the UPI ecosystem's funding gap and called for financial sustainability.

US holds back from helping Saudi Arabia after talks with Houthis in OmanUS officials met Houthi leaders in Muscat as Washington held back from direct intervention in Yemen. The talks shifted pressure to Saudi Arabia as the Houthis advanced along the Red Sea coast.

Adidas confirms layoffs at India tech hub, around 50% employees affectedAdidas is reportedly laying off nearly 50 per cent of its India Tech Hub workforce, with software engineers, data scientists and data engineers among those affected.

UPI fee is peanuts. Losing face for peanuts is nutsThe benefits of keeping UPI free outweighed the cost of keeping UPI free, but the government had an itch to fix what ain't broken. And that too, at a remarkable time.

Jharkhand power plant shut after Bangladesh PM skipped Brics meet, alleges BNP leaderA unit of Adani Power's Godda plant in Jharkhand, which supplies electricity to Bangladesh, had to be shut down last week due to a boiler problem. Ruhul Kabir Rizvi, the Acting General Secretary of PM Tarique Rahman's BNP, has alleged that the shutdown was linked to the Bangladesh leader skipping the Brics Summit in New Delhi.

Houthis shot down Saudi F-15 jet with locally made missile; video shows wreckageThe Houthis said they shot down a Saudi F-15 over Marib and later targeted a Saudi drone, as Riyadh pounds Yemen with airstrikes. Houthi-affiliated media released footage showing the aftermath of the shoot-down.

He said most everyday UPI payments will remain unaffected, while charges on bigger transactions will help make the digital payments system financially sustainable.

Forsaken by US and Pak, is Saudi Arabia playing the Mecca card?Saudi Arabia said it intercepted a Houthi drone that targeted Mecca, but the Iran-backed militia denied it aimed at the city that houses one of Islam's holiest sites. Riyadh's claim sparked consternation across the Muslim world. Is Saudi using the holy sites of Mecca and Medina as a levarage in the war against the Houthis?

Rohit Sharma retained, Auqib picked in India's ODI squad for West Indies seriesRohit Sharma and Virat Kohli will continue in India's ODI setup for the West Indies series, with Ravindra Jadeja making a return to the squad. Auqib Nabi and Naman Dhir have earned maiden ODI call-ups.

Woman marries partner, her family 'kidnaps' her; 6 hurt in Bengaluru car chaseA 21-year-old woman was allegedly taken from her Bengaluru home by four men linked to her family after her marriage against their wishes. The alleged abduction led to a local chase, multiple collisions and a police investigation centred on efforts to take her back to Rajasthan.

No foreign influence: Govt hits back at 'external pressure' charge on UPI feeThe government has rejected the opposition's charge that the introduction of a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on UPI payments was intended to benefit American card companies.

India rejects Pakistan-China Boundary Joint Commission, calls it legally baselessIndia rejected the so-called Pakistan-China Boundary Joint Commission and reaffirmed its position on Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. New Delhi said any such arrangement lacks legal basis and does not affect India's sovereignty.

Families on land reclaimed from gangster Atiq to celebrate Diwali on PM's birthdayPrayagraj's 76 PM Awas Yojana flats built on land reclaimed from Atiq Ahmed, will be lit with diyas on the eve of PM Modi's birthday.

Jarange Patil needs ICU care but heads to Mumbai for protests. CM questions timingMaratha quota activist Manoj Jarange Patil, who is on a fast for 19 days, is heading to Mumbai despite severe dehydration and a doctor's warning that he needs ICU care. Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis has questioned the timing of the Patil's march to Mumbai during Ganeshotsav.

Why IPS officer Bushra Bano's sudden transfer has stirred political storm in BengalThe sudden transfer of West Bengal IPS officer Bushra Bano has triggered a political controversy, days after a right-wing group objected to Islamic greetings she used in a video addressing students.

Asian Champions Trophy: Pakistan hockey refuses to play in India, seeks neutral venuePakistan have asked the Asian Hockey Federation to shift the Asian Champions Trophy from India or allow them to play their matches at a neutral venue. The decision from Pakistan comes just days after Punjab Chief Minister said that the men in green to play in Mohali and Jalandhar during the tournament.

Never met or knew Disha Salian: Aaditya Thackeray responds after name in FIRAaditya Thackeray has denied ever meeting Disha Salian and accused political rivals of targeting him, as the CBI begins a fresh probe into her 2020 death.

Why have Sooraj Pancholi, Rhea, Dino Morea been named in Disha Salian CBI FIR?The CBI has registered a fresh FIR in the Disha Salian death case, naming Rhea Chakraborty, Sooraj Pancholi and Dino Morea. The FIR covers allegations of gang rape, murder and a cover-up, with the CBI now investigating the claims.

She built a printer that turns speech into Braille. It won India's James Dyson AwardA visit to a school for visually impaired students led this 20-year-old Andhra Pradesh BTech student, Lingampalli Himaja, to build RUDHRA, a voice-enabled Braille printer. The project, now a James Dyson Award winner, is aimed at making Braille writing easier and more independent.

Pak navy ship collides with Indian warship, New Delhi summons Islamabad's top envoyThe MEA, in a strongly worded statement, said the unacceptable and unprofessional conduct of Pakistani naval units led to the collision. The development comes as tensions remains at an all-time high following last year's Operation Sindoor.

Bengal Assembly issues notices to 10 rebel TMC MLAs in defection caseThe West Bengal Assembly Secretariat has asked 10 rebel TMC MLAs to reply to disqualification notices within a week. The move brings the party's factional war into a formal anti-defection battle across multiple forums.

sports.headline: Hockey India dismisses Pakistan's request for ACT venue change Hockey India has rejected Pakistan's request to shift the Asian Champions Trophy from Punjab and move its matches elsewhere. Pakistan hockey sited security concerns about travelling to India as the reason for asking for a venue change.

Pakistan's Aisam Qureshi, former Bopanna partner, confirms Asian Games appearance Pakistan Tennis Federation president Aisam Qureshi, who reached the US Open men's doubles final with India's Rohan Bopanna, has confirmed he will compete in men's doubles at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya.

India begin Asian Games campaign in Teqball: Here is what the sport is all about India open their teqball campaign at the Asian Games with Mohamed Anas Imran Beg, Declan Marshall Gonsalves and Quimcy Dsouza in action. Here's a look at what the sport actually is, the rules and the scoring system.

WTA Finals to move to Charlotte in United States from 2027 The WTA Finals will move to Charlotte, North Carolina, from 2027, with the season-ending tournament set to be held there for at least three years as the women's tennis tour takes greater control of its flagship event.

Chess Olympiad: Indian men beat Thailand 3-1; women blank Dominican Republic World champion D Gukesh, Nihal Sarin and Vidit Gujrathi began India's men's campaign at the 46th Chess Olympiad with convincing victories, but Arjun Erigaisi's late collapse denied the team a clean sweep in a 3-1 win over Thailand on Wednesday.

Rishabh Pant ignored for ODI squad, named Rest of India captain for Irani Cup Rishabh Pant has been left out of India's ODI squad for the West Indies series but will return to action as captain of Rest of India in the Irani Cup. Pant will lead the side against maiden Ranji Trophy champions Jammu and Kashmir in the season-opening domestic fixture.

Kuldeep Yadav returns to T20I side, Nitish Kumar Reddy to miss Asian Games India have recalled Kuldeep Yadav for the five-match T20I series against West Indies. The announcement also confirmed Nitish Kumar Reddy's withdrawal from the Asian Games squad.

Rohit Sharma retained, Auqib picked in India's ODI squad for West Indies series Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli will continue in India's ODI setup for the West Indies series, with Ravindra Jadeja making a return to the squad. Auqib Nabi and Naman Dhir have earned maiden ODI call-ups.

The decision from Pakistan comes just days after Punjab Chief Minister said that the men in green to play in Mohali and Jalandhar during the tournament.

Chess Olympiad chaos: FIDE promises reimbursement after India lodging woes FIDE has promised to reimburse teams after accommodation failures left India and other teams without proper rooms in Samarkand. The Indian contingent was left stranded in the city's airport for more than five hours.

FIDE Chess Olympiad: Pakistan refuses to play Israel, gives 4-0 walkover Pakistan refused to face Israel in the opening round of the FIDE Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, handing Israel a 4-0 walkover. The Chess Federation of Pakistan said the boycott was in line with the government's policy towards Israel.

Asian Games boxing medallists to get direct entry into 2027 World ChampionshipsThe Boxing Federation of India has given 2026 Asian Games medallists direct entry to the 2027 World Championships. The policy creates a structured four-stage route to Los Angeles 2028 and sharpens selection around results.

England captain Brook eager to learn from hero Pietersen after historic tonHarry Brook is eager to learn from Kevin Pietersen after scoring a brilliant hundred in the first T20I win against Sri Lanka in Southampton on September 15. Pietersen joined England setup as their mentor in white-ball cricket.

Ash Barty set to make cricket comeback 10 years after last matchAsh Barty is set to return to cricket nearly a decade after her last competitive appearance, featuring in the T20 Cairns Gold Clash on November 22, 2026. The former world No.1 previously played for Brisbane Heat and Queensland before returning to tennis and winning three Grand Slam titles.

Alexandra Eala chooses country over China Open, seeks exemption for Asian GamesAlexandra Eala has chosen to represent the Philippines at the Asian Games over the mandatory China Open, with PHILTA seeking a WTA exemption. The world No.18 heads to Aichi-Nagoya after a breakthrough season featuring a WTA 500 title and strong Grand Slam runs.

IPL 2027 auction to return to India after three years abroad, says Arun DhumalThe IPL players' auction for the 2027 season is set to be held in India with league chairman Arun Dhumal saying that he is keen to bring the event back home after holding it overseas for the past three years.

10 sprint races, 24 races: FIA reveals F1 2027 calendarFormula 1 has put Monaco on the sprint roster and expanded the 2027 calendar to 24 races. There will be a total of 10 sprint races next season with Portugal and Turkey also returning to the calendar.

How Aashima Ahlawat struck a deal with mother: 98.6% in boards to Asian GamesAashima Ahlawat's journey from scoring 98.6 per cent in Class 12 to earning a place in India's Asian Games shooting team began with a deal with her mother. After overcoming early hurdles and winning an Asian bronze, the 22-year-old is now eyeing her Olympic dream while making her Asian Games debut in Aichi-Nagoya.

NADA bans athletics coach Rakesh Kumar for life over prohibited substancesNADA has barred athletics coach Rakesh Kumar for life and provisionally suspended powerlifter Gaurav Vats. The sanctions list also flags fresh doping cases across athletics and weightlifting.

Abhishek Sharma overtakes Sahibzada Farhan, closes in on Ishan Kishan for No.1 spotAbhishek Sharma has moved to No.2 in the ICC T20I batting rankings after scoring 121 runs in India's first two T20Is against Afghanistan. He is now just 51 rating points behind No.1 Ishan Kishan, while Sanju Samson has climbed to No.30.

WPL auction in Kochi on October 28, venues for season yet to be finalisedThe WPL 2027 auction is scheduled to be held in Kochi on October 28, while the BCCI continues to finalise venues for the fifth edition. Royal Challengers Bengaluru are the defending champions after they beat the Delhi Capitals in last edition's final.

Spinner Varun Chakravarthy ruled out after injury setbackAsian Games: Varun Chakravarthy has been ruled out of the remainder of India's Afghanistan T20I series and the Asian Games after suffering a side strain. The spinner had only recently returned following rehabilitation from a hamstring injury.

Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's father confident son will be ready when India need himIn an interview with India Today, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's father urged fans to continue blessing and supporting the youngster as he waits for his opportunity with the Indian team. Sooryavanshi is yet to play in the T20I series against Afghanistan.

Shreyanka Patil recovers from ankle injury, set to play in Asian GamesShreyanka Patil has recovered from her ankle injury and is set to return to competitive cricket at the 2026 Asian Games in Japan. Her coach Arjun Dev confirmed she is on her way to Japan after injuries forced her to miss the Asia Cup and part of the T20 World Cup.

Lionel Messi deserves Ballon d'Or 2026: Simeone picks Argentine over Mbappe, YamalAtletico Madrid manager Diego Simeone has backed Lionel Messi for the 2026 Ballon d'Or after Argentina's World Cup campaign. Messi remains among the leading contenders despite announcing his international retirement after the tournament.

Aryna Sabalenka cops hefty fine after racket abuse in US Open finalAryna Sabalenka was fined $7,500 for racket and ball abuse during and after her US Open final defeat to Elena Rybakina. Despite reaching the final without dropping a set, Sabalenka ended 2026 without a Grand Slam title and remains without a title since the Sunshine Double.

Accommodation no challenge: Sharath Kamal backs India athletes at Asian GamesIndia's athletes will face an unusual accommodation setup at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, but deputy chef-de-mission Sharath Kamal believes they have been prepared well. He expects the contingent to adapt quickly and remain focused on competition.

Shree Charani eyes historic T20I rankings milestone after stellar Women's Asia CupShree Charani has broken new ground in the ICC Women's T20I rankings, becoming the first Indian to cross the 800-point mark after her stellar Women's Asia Cup campaign. With 804 points, she is just two behind Megan Schutt's all-time record.

The goals will come back: Vinicius Jr vows to Real Madrid fans after Elche winVinicius Junior has admitted he needs to be more clinical after Real Madrid's narrow win over Elche. The Brazilian scored but missed several chances, before assuring fans that his goals will return in the coming matches.

IND vs WI squad announcement Highlights: No return for Hardik, Pant named ROI captainIndia (IND) vs West Indies (WI), ODI series squad announcement Highlights: There is no return for Hardik Pandya for the upcoming India vs West Indies ODIs and T20Is, while Rishabh Pant will be captaining Rest Of India during the Irani Trophy.

A large investment in international exposure, specialist support and a young pipeline reflects a longer-term attempt to build a team for the next decade.
